thread:
sam: Incident follow-up ask: make it <one click> from console row -> exact event payload in eventstore. Right now its 4 clicks and a grep.

anya: Agreed. Need stable quicklinks that include RBAC so support can share links with customers without leaking data.

keith: Proposal: a short token in the row (fb=xxxxxx) + a signed quicklink button "Open audit" that opens eventstore filtered by token. Signed URL expires after 10m by default.

ravi: Signed links are good, but we need tenant-scoped preview vs full JSON. UI should show a safe summary (no prompts) and a "View raw (RBAC)" that requires auth.

audit-bot: :information_source: feature-flag: "rw.fallback.quicklinks" scheduled for internal canary 2026-04-10.

sam: UX: keep row dense. Show token + tiny clipboard icon. Clicking the token gives a mini-menu: Copy token, Open audit (signed), Request share link (for cs).

anya: For operators, include a checkbox to include operator override metadata (who/reason/ttl) in the quicklink. Default false to avoid accidental exposure.

keith: Backend: quicklink service should validate permissions and optionally redact fields on-the-fly. Use a short signed path like /q/<token>?s=abc. The token maps to event id + precomputed allowed-views.

ravi: Telemetry: log quicklink opens (who, token, ip) for audit trail. Also add metric quicklinks.created and quicklinks.opened.

sam: Security: signed links must be single-use for high-sensitivity events. For normal fallbacks single-use not required but should be revocable.

anya: Also add a "copy as CLI" helper so support can paste `rw-fb inspect <token>` which opens the eventstore page. CLI should fetch via the signed link.

keith: Implementation note: decision_id generation remains same; quicklink maps decision_id -> viewset id. Keep signed link TTL configurable per-org. Hosted default 10m, enterprise can extend.

ravi: Tests: unit for sign/verify, e2e for UI quicklink + RBAC, and an incident rehearsal where support uses quicklinks to debug without escalating.

audit-bot: :bell: rollout-plan added to RFC. docs required: "How to share audit links safely" for support.

sam: One more UX: when a quicklink is generated in console, surface a tiny toast that warns if the button will include sensitive fields and remind to redact.

anya: And add a per-event flag "sensitive" to prevent quicklink generation unless explicit override by an operator.

keith: I'll sketch the quicklink microservice API and minimal frontend changes. Will include examples: header emission still optional; quicklinks handle the traceability leg.

ravi: Tagging @security and @support to review the RBAC surface and customer-facing notes.

sam: Thanks  will write RFC tonight and post in #eng-platform tomorrow.
